MEASUREMENT_DIMENSIONS.doc: The measurable dimensions a measurement document declares it covers: latency and cost since the format's 1.0, stability, RT safety and features since 1.1, for the hosting verdict.

text.en: How long a plugin takes to produce its first sound after it is driven or played.
How much CPU time a plugin spends per block under a sustained stimulus.
Whether a plugin instantiates, processes and tears down without crashing or producing non-finite output.
Whether a plugin's audio thread avoids locks, allocation and other calls a real-time thread must not make.
What capabilities a plugin declares and a prober can confirm, beside latency, cost, stability and RT safety.

MEASUREMENT_UNMEASURED_KINDS.doc: What an absent figure means for a merge, the one distinction that changes behaviour: a property of the plugin, a failure of this run, or a dimension the run did not cover.

nothingToMeasure.doc: A property of the plugin: any prober on any machine reaches it, so it may override a figure.

text.en: A property of the plugin: any prober on any machine reaches it, so it may override a figure.

probeFailed.doc: A property of this run: it says nothing about the plugin and never overrides a figure.

text.en: A property of this run: it says nothing about the plugin and never overrides a figure.

notAttempted.doc: The run did not cover this plugin or this dimension: a partial run, not a finding.

text.en: The run did not cover this plugin or this dimension: a partial run, not a finding.

MEASUREMENT_UNMEASURED_REASONS.doc: Every reason a figure may be absent, each of its kind: an outcome a sweep produced, never a hypothetical. A reader that meets a reason it does not know treats it as probe-failed.

noAudioIn.doc: No audio input port: nothing to drive.

text.en: No audio input port: nothing to drive.

noAudioOut.doc: No audio output port: nothing to read.

text.en: No audio output port: nothing to read.

silentOutput.doc: Driven, and silent under a stimulus that should have passed.

text.en: Driven, and silent under a stimulus that should have passed.

needsCarrier.doc: Needs a second audio input the prober did not supply.

text.en: Needs a second audio input the prober did not supply.

needsImpulseResponse.doc: A convolver needing an impulse response the prober did not load.

text.en: A convolver needing an impulse response the prober did not load.

needsContent.doc: An instrument that is silent under notes until a sample, a sound font or an instrument file is loaded, which the prober did not load.

text.en: An instrument that is silent under notes until a sample, a sound font or an instrument file is loaded, which the prober did not load.

unpinnable.doc: The files the host loads cannot be pinned.

text.en: The files the host loads cannot be pinned.

noVoices.doc: An instrument whose voice-info declares a capacity of 0.

text.en: An instrument whose voice-info declares a capacity of 0.

notesUnplayable.doc: An instrument whose note input reads no dialect the prober speaks.

text.en: An instrument whose note input reads no dialect the prober speaks.

voicesUnknown.doc: An instrument that declares no voice capacity, run with no probe count.

text.en: An instrument that declares no voice capacity, run with no probe count.

refusedInstantiation.doc: The plugin would not instantiate at this rate or block size.

text.en: The plugin would not instantiate at this rate or block size.

probeCrashed.doc: The probe worker died while hosting the plugin.

text.en: The probe worker died while hosting the plugin.

probeTimeout.doc: The probe passed its per-plugin time limit.

text.en: The probe passed its per-plugin time limit.

nonFiniteOutput.doc: The output held NaN or infinity.

text.en: The output held NaN or infinity.

notInstalled.doc: The plugin is not installed on this machine.

text.en: The plugin is not installed on this machine.

workerNonconforming.doc: An LV2 worker interface with work or work_response NULL.

text.en: An LV2 worker interface with work or work_response NULL.

probeError.doc: A failure with no more specific reason; its own words are kept beside it.

text.en: A failure with no more specific reason; its own words are kept beside it.

notAttempted.doc: The run did not cover this plugin for this dimension.

text.en: The run did not cover this plugin for this dimension.

MEASUREMENT_LATENCY_METHODS.doc: How a latency figure was taken. note-onset is an instrument's: a held note's first sound.

impulseOnset.doc: The delay from a unit impulse to the first output sample above the residual floor: what the plugin does.

text.en: The delay from a unit impulse to the first output sample above the residual floor: what the plugin does.

declaredPort.doc: Read from the plugin's own latency report: what it claims.

text.en: Read from the plugin's own latency report: what it claims.

noteOnset.doc: The delay from a note on to the first output sample above the floor.

text.en: The delay from a note on to the first output sample above the floor.

MEASUREMENT_COST_METHODS.doc: How a cost figure was taken.

blockTimePercentile.doc: A percentile of per-block wall time under a sustained stimulus, warm-up discarded, in nanoseconds per sample.

text.en: A percentile of per-block wall time under a sustained stimulus, warm-up discarded, in nanoseconds per sample.

MEASUREMENT_LATENCY_SCALING.doc: How latency moves with the sample rate, derived from readings at several rates, never assumed from a plugin's name.

fixedFrame.doc: The same frame count at every rate.

text.en: The same frame count at every rate.

fixedTime.doc: The same milliseconds at every rate.

text.en: The same milliseconds at every rate.

zero.doc: No latency a mix can notice at any measured rate.

text.en: No latency a mix can notice at any measured rate.

nonconforming.doc: Fits neither law at a magnitude that reaches a mix: flagged, never averaged.

text.en: Fits neither law at a magnitude that reaches a mix: flagged, never averaged.

singleRate.doc: One usable reading: no law can be fitted.

text.en: One usable reading: no law can be fitted.
No rate produced a figure.

MEASUREMENT_LATENCY_SCALING_NOTES.doc: Why a derived scaling class is not the naive fit over every reading.

belowBudget.doc: The readings fit no law but every one is inside the latency budget: the detector's noise.

text.en: The readings fit no law but every one is inside the latency budget: the detector's noise.

informationalRate.doc: Only a reading below the operational rates breaks the law; it stays as information.

text.en: Only a reading below the operational rates breaks the law; it stays as information.

MEASUREMENT_LATENCY_EXCLUSIONS.doc: Why one rate's reading was left out of the fit and of every rate resolution.

impossibleZero.doc: Zero frames at this rate while another rate measured non-zero.

text.en: Zero frames at this rate while another rate measured non-zero.

MEASUREMENT_VOICE_BASES.doc: Where the number of notes an instrument's cost was measured with came from: the voice capacity the plugin declares (CLAP voice-info), or a count the caller gave.

text.en: The voice capacity the plugin declares through CLAP's voice-info extension.
A note count the caller gave the prober, not read from the plugin.

MEASUREMENT_VERDICT_RATINGS.doc: The four ratings a verdict speaks, in order from the best.

text.en: The plugin meets the host profile's budget on every measured dimension.
The plugin meets the host profile's budget only under a stated condition.
Not enough was measured to rate the plugin against the host profile.
The plugin does not meet the host profile's budget on at least one measured dimension.
